Every light-column factor is even; the six triple-pair assignments have even total, proving uniform 2^(n-2) divisibility. Explicit sign columns give -2^(n-2) and a zero for n>=4. Direct finite cardinality/marginal counts give W=2 mod 4 at n=2,3. The convolution claims follow by character diagonalization. Independent exact-integer C++ and Python certificates verify all spectra n=2..5 (C++ through n=7), Parseval and the n=4 nullity 621.

value.rationale: C4-free labelled bipartite graphs are a standard natural family, and three fixed rows are the smallest shore size with three different conflicting row pairs. Exact recovery holds at widths two and three but fails abruptly at width four. The all-frequency sharp dyadic gap and exact pseudo-inverse norm quantify stable recovery of all surviving modes for every width; these invariants do not follow from mere counts. The theorem is a natural complete threshold and exact nonzero-gap classification, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
